title: Magic Carpets
description: Connect to a carpet for cheap, wireless buffs!
body:
I made a pack about a year ago, this is just a little simplified update! It's kinda neat I think.
Standing on a carpet will connect you to it and give you a potion effect related to its colour until you get to far away, or it breaks. You'll get an audible notification when any of these happen.

White - Regeneration\
Light Grey - Invisibility\
Grey - Night Vision\
Black - Trial Omen\
Brown - Slow Falling\
Red - Strength\
Orange - Fire Resistance\
Yellow - Haste\
Lime - Hero of the Village\
Green - Jump Boost\
Cyan - Dolphins Grace\
Light Blue - Speed\
Blue - Water Breathing\
Purple - Resistance\
Magenta - Levitation\
Pink - Absorption
